sources.snippet: Overview Gemma 4 26B A4B Instruct is the flagship server-class model in the Gemma 4 family, combining a 25.2B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts architecture with frontier-level reasoning and 256K context. Because only 3.8B parameters are activated per token, it delivers near-4B inference speed while matching the quality of far larger dense models. Validated for day-zero performance on Intel® Xeon ...

sources.snippet: Gemma 4 26B A4B IT Uncensored Heretic — Hardware Requirements & GPU Compatibility Vision Gemma 4 26B A4B IT Uncensored Heretic is a 25.8B-parameter open language model from llmfan46 in the Gemma 4 family. It supports a context window of up to 262,144 tokens. At Q4_K_M it needs about 16.13 GB of VRAM — see which GPUs and Macs can run it below.
